steps.text:
The debate clock is built and validates with 0 errors and 0 warnings. I recorded the final version and rendered every coverage frame, and I'd put all of it on air.

**Your buttons on NoaCG's control panel (all under "Floor"):**

| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Switch speaker** | Pauses whoever is speaking and starts the other speaker's clock from their own remaining time. The first press after a reset starts the Proposition speaker. |
| **Penalty** | Takes 10 seconds off whoever is speaking. Their clock keeps running, turns red, and a "−10" badge flashes on the centre line. Pressed when nobody is speaking, it does nothing. |
| **Reset clocks** | Puts both clocks back to the set time and stops them. |

Take, Update and Out work as usual.

**Fields the operator can type into:** round label ("DEBATE"), both side names ("PROPOSITION" / "OPPOSITION"), both speaker names, both clocks (to correct a time mid-debate, including while it's running), the set time (180 seconds by default) and the words "SEC EACH" in the header box. The penalty size is set once in the Data panel rather than on the operator page; it defaults to 10.

**Changes from NoaCG's built-in speaking-timer type:**
-...
